# Oxylabs.io

 > Oxylabs.io is a leading provider of proxy and web scraping solutions to help businesses collect large-scale web data. Their tools enable seamless data extraction while bypassing restrictions like IP blocks and CAPTCHAs. Oxylabs serves industries such as e-commerce, cybersecurity, SEO, and AI development, providing high-performance proxies and reliable customer support.
